This Subverse
/v/Intelligence is dedicated to providing the resources, tools, and information for the collection, analysis, and dissemination of intelligence to both the beginner and the experienced intelligence analyst. This community is starting from the ground up, and no resources, no matter how commonplace, are too well known to be posted.

 

This subverse has a community IRC channel that is open to everyone, with no topic constraints. Additionally, subverse mods may be reached via IRC, and dedicated members may inquire about community hosted BNC accounts. You can join us with the following information:

 

Server: irc.oftc.net:6697 (SSL)
Channel: #intelligence

 

No intelligence community would be complete without a wiki. As this is a Voat community, we’d like to keep as much of our resources as possible within Voat. Currently there is no wiki feature, however we want to give Voat a month or two to work things out and see what the plans are in that regard. We will host our own wiki if needed.

 

Community Guidelines

  • Intelligence Resources, Not Intel - This subverse is about the intelligence process, not intel itself. No news or current event postings. Please use other subverses for intel postings.

  • Hacking - Topics on Intelligence collection and hacking often overlap. Information about penetration testing, packet analysis, etc are permissible. Information regarding carding, botnets, DDoS attacks, etc are not.

  • Don’t Be An Ass - Self explanatory. While we’d like this subverse to be both useful and enjoyable, we understand that disagreements do happen. However, if your heated disagreements are both frequent and without merit, you will be banned.

 

Any and all feedback is welcome. Our aim is to be the intelligence community that you want to be a part of. Feel free to contact us (or reply) with any questions or suggestions.

 

Thanks for reading and we hope this subverse will be informative and edifying,
The Mods
